description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. In Matthew 12:40, we find the idea of 3 days and 3 nights just as Jonas was in the belly of the womb so shall thé Son of Man be in the heart of the earth. What’s the meaning of the heart of the earth? Is it in the tomb?  If it’s means tomb then how do we calculate the 3 days( evening and morning) to show that Christ really rose on Sunday? Some say 3 days means He rose on Monday. Please help me understand. 
.
.
.
